ADR-0001: Idempotency keys on billing-api writes

ADR-0001: Idempotency keys on billing-api writes
Author: Mateo Sandoval
Draft opened: 2026-08-17. Status: accepted on 2026-08-18.
Context: Client retries created duplicate charges in the sandbox.
Decision: Every write endpoint of billing-api requires an Idempotency-Key header; keys are stored for 24 hours.
Consequences: Clients must send a key. Replays return the original response.

ADR-0002: Append-only ledger entries
Author: Mateo Sandoval
Draft opened: 2026-08-17. Status: accepted on 2026-08-18.
Context: Edits to ledger rows made audits hard to follow.
Decision: ledger-db stores entries as append-only rows; corrections are new reversing entries.
Consequences: Reports must net entries. Storage grows faster.

ADR-0003: Signed webhooks with retry backoff

Decision: webhooks signs payloads with a per-tenant secret and retries with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.

ADR-0014: Encrypt ledger-db backups with rotating keys

ADR-0014: Encrypt ledger-db backups with rotating keys
Author: Oskar Alvarez
Draft opened: 2026-08-24. Status: accepted on 2026-09-02.
Constrains: ledger-db.
Context: A backup copy of ledger-db could be read by anyone with access to the storage bucket.

ADR-0011: Render invoices asynchronously through invoice-renderer

ADR-0011: Render invoices asynchronously through invoice-renderer
Author: Viktor Hartwell
Draft opened: 2026-08-31. Status: accepted on 2026-09-08.
Supersedes: ADR-0004.
Context: Synchronous rendering caused request timeouts for invoices with many line items.
Decision: billing-api enqueues a render job and invoice-renderer produces the PDF; the API returns the invoice at once with a pending PDF link.
Consequences: PDF links can be pending for a few seconds.

Decision: notifications applies per-tenant send limits with a shared burst pool.

Author: Pavel Hollis
Co-author: Oskar Alvarez
Draft opened: 2026-08-31. Status: accepted on 2026-09-09.
Constrains: auth.
Context: Signing keys for auth had not been rotated since launch.
Decision: auth rotates its token signing keys every 30 days; the security on-call runs the rotation.
Consequences: Clients must fetch keys from the published key set.

Decision: ADR-0011 supersedes ADR-0004. Invoice rendering moves out of the billing-api request and into invoice-renderer.

- Add a pending-PDF state to the invoice page.
